## 席位核对 · Amendment 2 · 2026-11-05T22:51Z · claim 6671504511 · option A, the context member

Measured by the dev on `main` `4bf9a2d7`: the three drill exits (`OpenInListButton` in the `DrillDownDrawer` header, `DrillDownDrawer`'s navigate-only arm, `ObjectChart`'s navigate-only arm and its own escape hatch) see only `!!openRecordList`; `exactRecordListFilter` needs the placeholder-resolved filter and the host's field read check (`usePermissions().checkField`) and lives in `app-shell`, which the widget packages may not import; moving it to `ui/packages/core` is ⛔ in the claim. So the widgets cannot tell without a new member, which is the case the claim reserved for an amendment.

Seat ruling: option A.

- File surface adds `ui/packages/react/src/context/DrillNavigationContext.tsx`: `DrillNavigationValue` gains an OPTIONAL `canOpenRecordList?(objectName: string, filter?: Record<string, unknown>): boolean`. Nothing else in `@object-ui/react` changes.
- The app-shell host implements it as placeholder resolution (the same `resolveFilterPlaceholders` call and scope `useOpenRecordList` uses) followed by `exactRecordListFilter([resolved], field => checkField read) !== null`, and `openRecordList` itself navigates only to what `exactRecordListFilter` writes (no destination when it answers `null`), so a widget that ignores the predicate still cannot open a wider list.
- The three exits offer a destination only when `openRecordList` exists and `canOpenRecordList` is absent or answers `true`. A `drillDown.target: 'navigate'` click with no exact destination falls back to the drawer, the same path as a host that wires no `openRecordList`.
- Pins as the claim lists, plus: a host without `canOpenRecordList` keeps today's behaviour; a single-equality drill writes a byte-identical URL.

Clause-②: yes (widening) — an optional member on a published `@object-ui/react` interface. It owes the seat's `TIER_DEFAULT` review at ACCEPT. The `.changeset/` file adds `@object-ui/react` at the level the repo's changeset rule gives a new optional interface member; the dev states it.

Everything else in claim 6671504511 and amendment 6671583364 stands.
